mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ADMIN WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT g.GROUP_ID AS groupId, g.TITLE AS title, g.OWNER_ID AS ownerId, o.NAME AS ownerName, g.STATUS AS status, g.VISIBILITY AS visibility, NVL(gm.ACTIVE_MEMBER_COUNT, 0) AS activeMemberCount, g.MAX_MEMBERS AS maxMembers, g.PAY_DAY AS payDay, g.AMOUNT AS amount, g.MONTHS AS months, g.ASSUMED_RATE AS assumedRate, acc.VERIFY_STATUS AS accountVerifyStatus, TO_CHAR(g.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM GYE_GROUP g JOIN MEMBER o ON o.MEMBER_ID = g.OWNER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS ACTIVE_MEMBER_COUNT FROM GYE_MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY GROUP_ID ) gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT GROUP_ID, VERIFY_STATUS FROM ( SELECT GROUP_ID, VERIFY_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY GROUP_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, GYE_ACCOUNT_ID DESC ) AS rn FROM GYE_ACCOUNT WHERE ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'CURRENT' ) WHERE rn = 1 ) acc ON acc.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID ORDER BY g.CREATED_AT DESC, g.GROUP_ID DESC

SELECT g.GROUP_ID AS groupId, g.TITLE AS title, g.PURPOSE AS purpose, g.REGION_SIDO AS regionSido, g.REGION_SIGUNGU AS regionSigungu, g.OWNER_ID AS ownerId, o.NAME AS ownerName, g.STATUS AS status, g.VISIBILITY AS visibility, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER gm WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS activeMemberCount, g.MAX_MEMBERS AS maxMembers, g.AMOUNT AS amount, g.MONTHS AS months, g.PAY_DAY AS payDay, g.ASSUMED_RATE AS assumedRate, g.OVERDUE_POLICY AS overduePolicy, g.ORDER_CONFIRMED_YN AS orderConfirmedYn, g.RULES_TITLE AS rulesTitle, g.RULES_BODY AS rulesBody, g.DESCRIPTION AS description, TO_CHAR(g.STARTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startedAt, TO_CHAR(g.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JOIN_REQUEST jr WHERE jr.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID) AS joinRequestCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JOIN_REQUEST jr WHERE jr.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND jr.STATUS = 'PENDING') AS pendingJoinRequestCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT_PROOF pp WHERE pp.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID) AS paymentProofCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT_PROOF pp WHERE pp.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND pp.STATUS <> 'CONFIRMED') AS pendingProofCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST wr WHERE wr.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID) AS withdrawalRequestCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST wr WHERE wr.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND wr.STATUS IN ('SETTLEMENT_PENDING', 'CONSENT_PENDING')) AS activeWithdrawalCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OVERDUE_CASE oc WHERE oc.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID) AS overdueCaseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OVERDUE_CASE oc WHERE oc.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND oc.STATUS <> 'RESOLVED') AS openOverdueCaseCount FROM GYE_GROUP g JOIN MEMBER o ON o.MEMBER_ID = g.OWNER_ID WHERE g.GROUP_ID = #{groupId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.GYE_ACCOUNT_ID AS gyeAccountId, a.BANK_NAME AS bankName, m.NAME AS registeredByName, a.ACCOUNT_NO_LAST4 AS accountNoLast4, a.VERIFY_STATUS AS verifyStatus, a.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus, TO_CHAR(a.REQUESTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS requestedAt, TO_CHAR(a.VERIFIED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS verifiedAt FROM GYE_ACCOUNT a LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = a.REGISTERED_BY WHERE a.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND a.ACCOUNT_STATUS = #{accountStatus} ORDER BY a.CREATED_AT DESC, a.GYE_ACCOUNT_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT l.AUDIT_LOG_ID AS auditLogId, l.GROUP_ID AS groupId, NVL(g.TITLE, '플랫폼 공통') AS groupTitle, l.EVENT_TYPE AS eventType, l.ACTOR_ADMIN_ID AS actorAdminId, a.NAME AS adminName, l.ACTOR_MEMBER_ID AS actorMemberId, m.NAME AS memberName, l.TARGET_MEMBER_ID AS targetMemberId, tm.NAME AS targetMemberName, l.DESCRIPTION AS description, TO_CHAR(l.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM AUDIT_LOG l LEFT JOIN GYE_GROUP g ON g.GROUP_ID = l.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN ADMIN a ON a.ADMIN_ID = l.ACTOR_ADMIN_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.ACTOR_MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER tm ON tm.MEMBER_ID = l.TARGET_MEMBER_ID
ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT DESC, l.AUDIT_LOG_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
